# netskope_aig_token (Data Source)

AIGToken DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_token" "my_aigtoken" {
  id = "019812aa-bdba-7a48-baa2-2de8c6006fdb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the token.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the token is active.
- `expire_time` (String) Timestamp when the token expires. Null if no expiry.
- `name` (String) Name of the token.
- `token_group_id` (String) ID of the token group this token belongs to.
